# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old at his first appearance  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Rank:** Fourth book student at Brierley school  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Hughie  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Hugh is a tall, handsome boy with wavy chestnut hair, mischievous light-brown eyes, and a mocking grin. He has a high stature and good looks.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)_

## Personality

Hugh is a tall, handsome, and mischievous boy who enjoys teasing the girls at school. Despite his playful pranking, he is brave enough to take responsibility for provoking others and apologizes when he realizes he has genuinely hurt someone's feelings. He is academically talented, accustomed to leading his class, and determined to succeed.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049)_

- Lead his class at school  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- Reconcile with Nell after teasing her  <sub>[v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049)</sub>

## History

Hugh spent several years in Alberta due to his father's illness, returning to Brierley after lacking regular schooling. During the summer before his return to Brierley school, he visited cousins in New Brunswick. Upon returning to class in the fourth book, he pulled a prank on Opal Pettigrew by tying her hair to her chair and teased the new student, Nell Harcourt, by pulling her hair and calling her 'Carrots'. In response, Nell smashed her slate over his head. Hugh bravely admitted to the schoolmaster, Mr. Pidgeon, that he had provoked her. After school, Hugh tried to apologize to Nell for mocking her hair, but she snubbed him. When Mr. Pidgeon later forced Nell to sit next to Hugh as a punishment for being late, Hugh tried to offer her a candy heart, which she crushed under her shoe. Later in the school year, Hugh performed a recitation of 'Bingen on the Rhine' at the Debating Club concert and picked up a rose that dropped from Nell's hair. Hugh competed fiercely with Nell for top academic marks in the fifth class, excelling in geometry, spelling, and arithmetic.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v1 c19 P40](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0040), [v1 c25 P55](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0055)_

## Background by volume

- Spent three years in Alberta while his father was ill  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- Spent the summer visiting cousins in New Brunswick before returning to Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- His family resides across the Lake of Glassy Waters and owns an ancient orchard  <sub>[v1 c17 P24](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0024)</sub>
